1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 灵芝药的夹竹桃：灵芝和夹竹桃，The particle 的 makes the preceding words an attributive modifier, but these are two plant names that need the coordinating word 和. [rule: attributive_modifier_de]

items.reason: “灵芝药的夹竹桃” wrongly expresses the relationship; the intended meaning is lingzhi that can be used as an antidote to oleander, not “灵芝和夹竹桃.”
